title: Cluster marker-matched statement ranges before long-method extraction
wanted_capability: Given compact statement matches for a marker in a long Java method, the analysis surface should group nearby matches into contiguous candidate clusters and summarize each cluster's line range, statement count, live-out count, capture shape, and whether it exercises a requested construct such as result-record extraction.
missing_primitive: Marker-match cluster ranking for analysis.methodRegions on long methods
fallback_used: The probe manually inspected scattered marker matches and drifted to the easiest single-live-out block instead of the intended multi-live-out construct target.
notes: Generic finding from a private Java probe. The existing compact marker search reduced output size, but did not rank candidate clusters by the construct under test, so the agent selected a valid but irrelevant easier extraction.
